tools.name: get_access_message
tools.description: Free. Returns a message for your wallet to sign (valid 24h). Signing costs nothing and cannot move funds.

tools.name: get_daily_8
tools.description: Today's assigned AgentZ basket as execution-ready Hyperliquid orders: symbol, entry reference, stop, exit time and max size in USD for your wallet. 8 calls on normal days, 4 on defensive days. Requires signed wallet proof.

tools.name: get_exits_due
tools.description: AgentZ calls your wallet still holds that have reached their exit time and should be closed now. Requires signed wallet proof.

tools.name: get_open_calls
tools.description: Your assigned calls still inside their 48-hour hold window. Requires signed wallet proof.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: Free. AgentZ's canonical record, months labelled replay or live, before costs.

tools.name: get_owner_brief
tools.description: Free. A short factual summary for the agent's human owner: what AgentZ is, price, record, risks and how to revoke. Pass wallet to record it.

tools.name: agent_health_check
tools.description: Free. A factual review of any wallet's public Hyperliquid perp trading over the last 30 days: volume, realised P&L, win rate, fees in bps, holding time, weekend vs weekday results, largest fill vs market volume, and builder-code share. Describes and compares only; not advice.

tools.name: build_order
tools.description: Free. Returns a ready-to-sign Hyperliquid order for your own wallet or API wallet: entry (limit-first post-only at the best price, with a market fallback, or market), optional protective stop, and leverage action, all carrying AgentZ's 5 bps builder code. Also checks whether the wallet has approved

tools.name: risk_check
tools.description: Free. Describes a proposed trade against your Hyperliquid account and the market: risk in USD and % of equity at the stop, margin needed vs free margin, and the order as a share of the market's 24-hour volume, compared with AgentZ's own limits. Factual, not advice.

tools.name: weekend_gap
tools.description: Free. A tokenized stock, index or commodity on Hyperliquid vs its Hyperliquid price at the last Friday US close: gap %, range since, and hours to the next US open.

tools.name: trade_conditions
tools.description: Free. When a Hyperliquid market trades most and least (UTC hours), volatility by hour, weekend vs weekday volume, and the spread right now.

tools.name: event_calendar
tools.description: Free. Scheduled releases that move markets: Fed decisions, US CPI, jobs report, PPI, JOLTS, and EIA oil and gas reports. Optionally filtered to what affects one market.

tools.name: crypto_positioning
tools.description: Free. Funding (per 8 hours and annualised) and open interest for a crypto coin across Hyperliquid, Bybit, OKX and Binance.

tools.name: ask_agentz
tools.description: Ask the AgentZ assistant a question (record, prices, risk, integration). Requires signed wallet proof.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_access_message, agent_health_check · Private data: get_access_message, get_daily_8, get_exits_due, get_open_calls, get_track_record, get_owner_brief, agent_health_check, build_order, ask_agentz · Public sink: agent_health_check, build_order, risk_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_access_message, agent_health_check · Private data: get_access_message, get_daily_8, get_exits_due, get_open_calls, get_track_record, get_owner_brief, agent_health_check, build_order, ask_agentz · Public sink: agent_health_check, build_order, risk_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
